subject: science
passage: Radishes grow quickly, which makes them useful for testing how much water a crop needs. Gardener Hanna Virtanen planted 40 radish seeds in each of four raised beds in Tampere, Finland, and watered each bed on a different schedule for five weeks. She then weighed all the radishes harvested from each bed. In her trial, the heaviest total harvest came from the bed watered ______

data.title: Radish Harvest under Four Watering Schedules (40 seeds per bed)

stem: Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the statement?

choices.A: every 7 days, which produced the smallest number of radishes.
choices.B: every 3 days, which produced the heaviest radishes.
choices.C: every 2 days, which produced 3.9 kilograms of radishes.
choices.D: every day, when 36 radishes were harvested.

explanation.why: The statement is about the heaviest total harvest, so look at the "Total harvest (kg)" column and find the largest value. The largest is 3.9 kilograms, in the "Every 2 days" row.
explanation.A: Incorrect. The bed watered every 7 days gave the lightest harvest (1.4 kilograms), not the heaviest.
explanation.B: Incorrect. The table has no bed watered every 3 days.
explanation.C: Correct. The bed watered every 2 days produced 3.9 kilograms, more than any other bed.
explanation.D: Incorrect. This number is accurate, but it counts radishes rather than weighing them, and the daily-watered bed's 3.1 kilograms is less than 3.9.
